paragraphs: The X5 M Competition sits at the top of the X5 M range, sharing the same S63 twin-turbo V8 as the standard X5 M but in a higher-output tune. The F95 generation, introduced in 2019, represents the third generation of X5 M — and the S63 family has powered every version since the model's launch in 2009. The hot-vee pattern that affects the S63 is consistent across all generations, which means the same preventative component replacement applies whether your car is an early E70 or a current F95.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 M Competition is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
